name: Reckless Sympathy
source:
Torn away from her comfortable position under the woman she grew up serving, Anmarie Uztempo travels to the edge of the kingdom to start a new life as a rank-and-file maid for the aristocratic Vas Holy family.

Despite her best efforts, Anmarie’s strange mannerisms soon draw the eye of the last heir of the family, the enigmatic Glory. Dreams of a quiet life turn to ash on her lips as Anmarie uncovers exactly what kind of person she really is, and all the things she’s been holding back.

Reckless Sympathy is a horror/romance visual novel about the entanglement of an empath, a monster, and a fake as they lick each other’s wounds raw. It’s about how feelings fall short. It’s about blood.

[From [url=https://bennends.itch.io/reckless-sympathy]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
安玛丽·乌兹坦波 (Anmarie Uztempo) 离开了她从小侍奉的女人的舒适地位，来到王国的边缘，开始了新的生活，成为贵族瓦斯·霍利家族 (Vas Holy family) 的普通女仆。

尽管安玛丽尽了最大努力，但她奇怪的举止很快就引起了家族最后一位继承人、神秘的荣耀的注意。当安玛丽发现自己到底是什么样的人，以及她一直隐瞒的所有事情时，平静生活的梦想变成了灰烬。

《鲁莽的同情》是一部恐怖/浪漫视觉小说，讲述了移情者、怪物和冒牌者之间纠缠不清的故事，他们互相舔舐对方的伤口。这是关于感情如何不足的问题。这是关于血的。

[来自[url=https://bennends.itch.io/reckless-sympathy]itch.io[/url]]
